name_fa: درآمد خالص روزانه (فروش آنلاین + قرارداد سازمانی − بازپرداخت)
sql: SELECT d, ROUND((b2c+b2b)/1e6,1) value FROM revenue_daily

name_fa: تحقق هدف درآمد ماه تا امروز (نسبت به هدف تناسبی) — هشدار فقط از روز ۸ ماه
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT c.d, c.jmonth, c.day_in_month, c.mdays, SUM(r.b2c + r.b2b) OVER (PARTITION BY c.jmonth ORDER BY c.d) cum FROM cal c JOIN revenue_daily r USING(d)) SELECT m.d, ROUND(100.0*m.cum/(t.target_million_toman*1e6*m.day_in_month/m.mdays),1) value FROM m JOIN monthly_targets t ON t.jmonth=m.jmonth AND t.scope='ORG'
SELECT date(delivered_at) d, ROUND(100.0*AVG(delivered_at<=promised_by),1) value FROM order_fact WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
SELECT date(answered_at) d, ROUND(AVG(score),2) value FROM csat GROUP BY 1

name_fa: میانه زمان پاسخ اول پشتیبانی (خط اول: تیکت‌های تیم پاسخ‌گویی)
sql: SELECT date(first_response_at) d, ROUND(median((julianday(first_response_at)-julianday(created_at))*24),2) value FROM ticket_fact WHERE first_response_at IS NOT NULL AND team_id='T_RSP' GROUP BY 1
SELECT c.d, COUNT(o.order_id) value FROM cal c LEFT JOIN orders o ON date(o.created_at)=c.d GROUP BY c.d

name_fa: Workflow سفارش تا تحویل — درصد در SLA (پرداخت≤۱س، جمع‌آوری≤۱۲س، تحویل به ارسال≤۶س، تحویل≤موعد)
sql: SELECT date(delivered_at) d, ROUND(100.0*AVG((julianday(paid_at)-julianday(created_at))*24<=1 AND (julianday(picked_at)-julianday(paid_at))*24<=12 AND (julianday(handed_over_at)-julianday(picked_at))*24<=6 AND delivered_at<=promised_by),1) value FROM order_fact WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

name_fa: Workflow شکایت تا حل — درصد حل‌شده ظرف ۴۸ ساعت
sql: SELECT date(resolved_at) d, ROUND(100.0*AVG((julianday(resolved_at)-julianday(created_at))*24<=48),1) value FROM ticket_fact WHERE team_id='T_CMP' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

name_fa: Workflow سرنخ تا قرارداد — درصد در SLA (۷ روز اخیر)
sql: WITH cl AS (SELECT lead_id, COALESCE(won_at,lost_at) closed_at, ((julianday(first_contact_at)-julianday(created_at))*24<=24 AND (julianday(proposal_at)-julianday(qualified_at))*24<=120 AND (julianday(COALESCE(won_at,lost_at))-julianday(proposal_at))*24<=720) ok FROM lead_fact WHERE COALESCE(won_at,lost_at) IS NOT NULL) SELECT c.d, ROUND(100.0*AVG(cl.ok),1) value FROM cal c JOIN cl ON date(cl.closed_at) BETWEEN date(c.d,'-6 day') AND c.d GROUP BY c.d
SELECT d, ROUND(b2c/1e6,1) value FROM revenue_daily
SELECT s.d, ROUND(100.0*o.n/s.n,2) value FROM (SELECT date d, SUM(sessions) n FROM web_sessions GROUP BY 1) s JOIN (SELECT date(created_at) d, COUNT(*) n FROM orders GROUP BY 1) o USING(d)
SELECT date(created_at) d, ROUND(100.0*AVG(failed_at IS NOT NULL),2) value FROM order_fact GROUP BY 1

name_fa: نرخ پرداخت ناموفق به تفکیک کانال
sql: SELECT date(created_at) d, channel dim, ROUND(100.0*AVG(failed_at IS NOT NULL),2) value FROM order_fact GROUP BY 1,2

name_fa: تماس اول با سرنخ ظرف ۲۴ ساعت
sql: SELECT date(first_contact_at) d, ROUND(100.0*AVG((julianday(first_contact_at)-julianday(created_at))*24<=24),1) value FROM lead_fact WHERE first_contact_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

WITH cl AS (SELECT COALESCE(won_at,lost_at) closed_at, won_at IS NOT NULL won FROM lead_fact WHERE COALESCE(won_at,lost_at) IS NOT NULL) SELECT c.d, ROUND(100.0*AVG(cl.won),1) value FROM cal c JOIN cl ON date(cl.closed_at) BETWEEN date(c.d,'-29 day') AND c.d GROUP BY c.d
SELECT c.d, COUNT(l.lead_id) value FROM cal c LEFT JOIN lead_fact l ON date(l.proposal_at) <= c.d AND (COALESCE(l.won_at,l.lost_at) IS NULL OR date(COALESCE(l.won_at,l.lost_at)) > c.d) GROUP BY c.d

sql: SELECT c.d, ROUND(SUM(r.b2b) OVER (PARTITION BY c.jmonth ORDER BY c.d)/1e6,1) value FROM cal c JOIN revenue_daily r USING(d)

SELECT c.d, COUNT(t.task_id) value FROM cal c LEFT JOIN task_fact t ON t.team_id='T_ENT' AND t.due_date < c.d AND date(t.created_at) <= c.d AND (t.done_at IS NULL OR date(t.done_at) > c.d) GROUP BY c.d
SELECT date d, SUM(leads) value FROM mkt_daily GROUP BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT date d, SUM(spend_toman) s, SUM(leads) l FROM mkt_daily GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.d, ROUND(SUM(x.s)/NULLIF(SUM(x.l),0)/1000.0,0) value FROM cal c JOIN x ON x.d BETWEEN date(c.d,'-6 day') AND c.d GROUP BY c.d
SELECT date d, ROUND(SUM(spend_toman)/1e6,1) value FROM mkt_daily GROUP BY 1

name_fa: نرخ کالای معیوب (تیکت معیوب ÷ سفارش تحویل‌شده)
sql: SELECT c.d, ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(t.n,0)/o.n,2) value FROM cal c JOIN (SELECT date(delivered_at) d, COUNT(*) n FROM order_fact WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) o ON o.d=c.d LEFT JOIN (SELECT date(created_at) d, COUNT(*) n FROM tickets WHERE category='کالای معیوب' GROUP BY 1) t ON t.d=c.d

name_fa: نرخ کالای معیوب به تفکیک دسته کالا (۷ روز اخیر)
sql: WITH dl AS (SELECT date(delivered_at) d, category, COUNT(*) n FROM order_fact WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2), dm AS (SELECT date(t.created_at) d, o.category, COUNT(*) n FROM tickets t JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE t.category='کالای معیوب' GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT c.d, dl.category dim, ROUND(100.0*COALESCE((SELECT SUM(n) FROM dm WHERE dm.category=dl.category AND dm.d BETWEEN date(c.d,'-6 day') AND c.d),0) /SUM(dl.n),2) value FROM cal c JOIN dl ON dl.d BETWEEN date(c.d,'-6 day') AND c.d GROUP BY c.d, dl.category
